en.text: In the matter of foods, we do not already consider the rare things to be altogether even more pleasant than the abundant things.
en.source_text:
ἐ̣π̣ὶ τῶν βρω̣μ̣άτ̣ων
ο̣ὐ̣κ ἤδ̣η τὰ σπάνια
πάντωϲ̣ καὶ ἡδ̣ίω
τῶν δ̣αψιλῶν̣ ε̣ἶναι̣
νομίζ̣ο̣με̣ν·
en.notes: The supplied transcription carries sublinear dots on many letters indicating uncertain readings, distributed across all five lines as given. No square brackets indicating editorial supplement appear in the data. No question-mark character appears in the data; the final mark after νομίζομεν is transcribed as ano teleia. The translation renders the letters as printed without inventing missing words.

ta.text: உணவுகள் விஷயத்தில், அரிதானவை மிகுதியாக உள்ளவற்றை விட எல்லா வகையிலும் மிகவும் இனிமையானவை என்று நாம் ஏற்கனவே கருதுவதில்லை.
